title: Khaakar sina jo seene pa akber guzar gaye
body:
Khakar Sinaa Jo Seene Pa Akbar Guzar Gaye
Bole Hussain Aye Mahe, Anwar Kidhar Gaye
Peeri Me Ghar Hussain Ka, Barbaad Kar Gaye
Zaqm-E Jigar Se Tum, Shafaq-E Khoo'n Me Bhar Gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham Se Yeh Haal Hai Ke, Bahot Beqaraar Hoo'n
Awaaz Dou Ke Aan Ke Tumpar Nisaar Hoo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaakar Sinaa Jo Seene Pa Akbar Guzar Gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Zalimou'n Ghareeb Hoo'n, Aur Bedayaar Hoo'n
Are Bhoole Ho Kyu'n, Rasool Ka Mai Yaadgaar Hoo'n
Lillah Mujhpa Rahem Karo, Beqaraar Hoo'n
Are Beta Jawaan Margaya, Mai Soghwaar Hoo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir Dekhloo'n Us Apne, Saadath Nashaan Ko
Barchi Kahaa'n Lagi Mere, Kadyal Jawaan Ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaakar Sinaa Jo Seene Pa Akbar Guzar Gaye
